scripts.build: npm run build:extension && uv run jupyter lite build --contents content --output-dir _output --LiteBuildConfig.federated_extensions=packages/notebookpilot/labextension
scripts.build:extension: tsc -p packages/notebookpilot/tsconfig.json && esbuild packages/notebookpilot/src/runtime/worker-entry.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=packages/notebookpilot/lib/runtime/python.worker.js && uv run python scripts/prepare_core.py && build-labextension --core-path build/core packages/notebookpilot
scripts.test: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v && npm run test:unit
scripts.lint:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts e2e/*.ts eval packages/notebookpilot/package.json packages/notebookpilot/tsconfig*.json packages/notebookpilot/jest.config.cjs packages/notebookpilot/src packages/notebookpilot/tests packages/notebookpilot/style
